extracted.intended_audience: general newspaper readers and policymakers interested in post‑war relief, food policy, and international affairs
extracted.subtask_description: A multi-article newspaper page reporting on post‑World War II topics: international food shipments and shortages, UNRRA appeals, political developments and elections in Asia, and U.S. policy debates. It collects brief news items and quotes from officials and observers relevant to relief and foreign policy.
